Before we can move forward, I need to make sure we have all the pieces in place. Studio policy requires current written clearance reports from rights, sound, and talent before I can release anything to production. So let's talk through where we stand on each of those, and on the production plan itself.

I confirmed with the distribution platform's ingest engineer that delivery must be stereo at 48 kHz with mono compatibility. Binaural delivery will be rejected outright. That engineer's specification was added to the technical ticket, but it hasn't made it into the greenlight packet yet. Given that the draft plan calls for binaural audio, we need to address this before the package goes to production.
